description: This file contains functions for validating tool names and their usage within different modes, including checks for tool validity, mode restrictions, and file path regex validation.

methods.name: isValidToolName
methods.description: Checks if a tool name is a valid, known tool, including static, custom, and dynamic MCP tools.

methods.name: validateToolUse
methods.description: Validates whether a tool can be used in a specific mode, throwing errors if invalid or disallowed.

methods.name: isToolAllowedForMode
methods.description: Determines if a given tool is permitted in a specific mode, considering mode groups, custom tools, and regex restrictions on file paths.
